Pocket AI native dependencies (CPU only, no downloads at application runtime)

llama.cpp https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp
revision ae93877c8f3bf9f39f0ee4ffb3ef1697c416a7c3
license MIT (see llama.cpp/LICENSE)

whisper.cpp https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp
revision 5922450fbce1ed9d1648babd0d5ac4520055b436
license MIT (see whisper.cpp/LICENSE)

Whisper uses the single GGML implementation supplied by pinned llama.cpp.
Whisper tiny speech weights are supplied separately by the pinned asset script.
Optional GGUF weights may be imported through Models. Header validation is not
a guarantee of compatibility or quality. See the offline asset manifest for
separately pinned retrieval/translation weights.

arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a (NEON), x86_64: CPU GGUF generation and Whisper
ggml transcription; available memory and model compatibility are checked.

SentencePiece https://github.com/google/sentencepiece
revision 31646a467d2051eb904e0b45de3a73e91fe1c1e3 (v0.2.1)
license Apache-2.0; bundled processor dependencies retain BSD-3-Clause/Apache
licenses in sentencepiece/third_party. Only sentencepiece-static is linked.
No model weights, trainer target, or CLI executable are included in this runtime.
Native UTF-8 byte-array JNI exposes raw encode/decode IDs and pieces.
